articles.title_en: Employer Screening and Optimal Unemployment Insurance
articles.title_cn: 雇主筛选与最优失业保险
articles.abstract_en: Field experiments show that employers are less likely to consider long-term unemployed job seekers for interviews. We study the implications for optimal unemployment insurance. Based on a structural model of job search and recruitment, estimated with German data, we analyse the optimal two-tier unemployment system. We find that screening makes the optimal initial benefit level 4 percentage points higher and the potential benefit duration seven months longer. Using an extended Baily–Chetty formula, we study the mechanisms through which screening affects the consumption smoothing gain and moral hazard cost of providing unemployment insurance and highlight the role of the externality from endogenous firm behaviour.
articles.abstract_cn: 实地实验表明，雇主不太可能考虑长期失业的求职者进行面试。我们研究了这对最优失业保险的影响。基于一个用德国数据估计的求职与招聘结构模型，我们分析了最优的两级失业制度。我们发现，筛选使得最优初始福利水平高出4个百分点，潜在福利持续时间延长七个月。利用扩展的Baily-Chetty公式，我们研究了筛选通过何种机制影响提供失业保险的消费平滑收益和道德风险成本，并强调了内生企业行为外部性的作用。

articles.title_en: Maternal Investments in Children: The Role of Expected Effort and Returns
articles.title_cn: 母亲对子女的投资：预期努力与回报的作用
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the importance of subjective expectations of returns to and effort costs of the two principal investments that mothers make in newborns: breastfeeding and stimulation. We find heterogeneity across mothers in rural Pakistan in expected effort costs and expected returns for outcomes in the cognitive, socio-emotional and health domains, and that this contributes to explaining heterogeneity in investments. We find no significant differences across women in preferences for child developmental outcomes. We simulate the impact of alternative policies on investments. Our findings highlight the relevance of interventions designed to address maternal depression and reduce perinatal fatigue alongside interventions that increase perceived returns to investments.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了母亲在新生儿身上进行的两种主要投资——母乳喂养和刺激——的预期回报和努力成本的主观预期的重要性。我们发现，在巴基斯坦农村地区，母亲们在认知、社会情感和健康领域的结果预期努力成本和预期回报方面存在异质性，并且这有助于解释投资中的异质性。我们发现女性在儿童发展结果的偏好上没有显著差异。我们模拟了替代政策对投资的影响。我们的发现强调了旨在解决母亲抑郁和减少围产期疲劳的干预措施，以及提高投资感知回报的干预措施的相关性。

articles.title_en: The Road to Crime: An Unintended Consequence of the Interstate Highway System
articles.title_cn: 通往犯罪之路：州际公路系统的一个意外后果
articles.abstract_en: The necessity to overhaul national infrastructure has become one of the key issues of US domestic policy in recent years. While the benefits of infrastructure spending are often straightforward, its unintended consequences are less well understood. This paper studies the impact of transportation infrastructure on local crime, focusing on the construction of the Interstate Highway System, the largest public works project in US history. Using a staggered difference-in-differences design and a county-by-year panel dataset spanning all US counties between 1960 and 1993, we find that a highway opening in a county led to an 8% rise in total index crime. This effect is driven by property crime (burglary, larceny and motor vehicle theft), although some evidence suggests an increase in violent crime as well. Exploring potential mechanisms, we show that the positive effect of highways on crime is concentrated in counties with low pre-existing stock of police resources where increased connectivity may have raised the returns to crime. Moreover, we find that highway construction induced higher local employment, average firm size and the local population size, thus increasing the returns to criminal activity, and ultimately the risk of victimisation in the newly connected counties.
articles.abstract_cn: 近年来， overhaul 国家基础设施的必要性已成为美国国内政策的关键问题之一。虽然基础设施支出的益处往往显而易见，但其意外后果却鲜为人知。本文研究了交通基础设施对地方犯罪的影响，重点关注美国历史上最大的公共工程项目——州际公路系统的建设。利用交错双重差分设计以及覆盖1960年至1993年间美国所有县级的县级年度面板数据集，我们发现，一个县内高速公路的开通导致总体指数犯罪率上升了8%。这一效应主要由财产犯罪（入室盗窃、盗窃和机动车盗窃）驱动，尽管也有部分证据表明暴力犯罪有所增加。在探索潜在机制时，我们表明，高速公路对犯罪的正面效应集中在警察资源存量较低的县，这些地区连通性的增强可能提高了犯罪的回报。此外，我们发现，高速公路建设带动了当地就业、平均企业规模和当地人口规模的增加，从而提高了犯罪活动的回报，并最终增加了新连通县居民受害的风险。

articles.abstract_en: We use novel survey data from Italy to shed light on key questions regarding the measurement of social capital and the use of social capital indicators for empirical work. Our data cover a sample of over 600,000 respondents interviewed between 2000 and 2015. We identify four distinct components of social capital—(i) social participation, (ii) political participation, (iii) general trust and (iv) trust in institutions—and examine how they relate to each other. We then study how each dimension of social capital relates to various socio-economic factors, both at the individual and aggregate levels, and to various proxies of social capital commonly used in the literature. Finally, building on previous work, we investigate to what extent different dimensions of social capital predict differences in key economic, political and health outcomes. Our findings support the view that social capital is a multi-faceted object with multiple dimensions that, while related, are distinct from each other. Future work should take such multi-dimensionality into account and carefully consider what measure of social capital to use.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用来自意大利的新颖调查数据，就社会资本测量及社会资本指标在实证研究中的应用等关键问题进行了探讨。我们的数据涵盖了在2000年至2015年间受访的超过600,000名受访者样本。我们识别出社会资本的四个不同组成部分——(i)社会参与、(ii)政治参与、(iii)普遍信任及(iv)对机构的信任——并考察它们之间的相互关系。随后，我们研究了社会资本的每个维度如何与个人及总体层面的各种社会经济因素，以及文献中常用的各种社会资本代理指标相关联。最后，基于先前的研究，我们探讨了社会资本的不同维度在多大程度上预测了关键经济、政治和健康结果的差异。我们的发现支持了这样一种观点：社会资本是一个多层面的对象，具有多个维度，这些维度虽相互关联，但彼此又有所区别。未来的研究应考虑到这种多维性，并仔细斟酌应使用何种社会资本衡量指标。

articles.title_en: Local exposure to refugees changed attitudes to ethnic minorities in the Netherlands
articles.title_cn: 当地接触难民改变了荷兰人对少数民族的态度
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the effect of exposure to refugees on locals’ preferences with regard to ethnic minorities using individual-level panel data from the Netherlands. The data combine self-reported preferences with administrative data on the residential locations of the locals and the refugees. The study period is marked by a sudden inflow of refugees in some neighbourhoods. We find that individuals living close to newly installed refugee facilities developed a more positive attitude towards ethnic minorities and became less supportive of anti-immigration parties compared to individuals living farther away. An investigation of mechanisms suggests that the local effect is due to contact between residents and refugees.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用荷兰的个体层面面板数据，研究接触难民对当地人对少数民族偏好的影响。数据将自我报告的偏好与关于当地人和难民居住地点的行政数据相结合。研究期间以某些社区突然涌入难民为特征。我们发现，与居住在较远地方的个体相比，居住在新建难民设施附近的个体对少数民族形成了更积极的态度，并且对反移民政党的支持度降低。对机制的研究表明，当地效应是由于居民与难民之间的接触所致。

articles.title_en: Earnings Responses to Even Higher Taxes
articles.title_cn: 对更高税收的收入反应
articles.abstract_en: We exploit a recent Swedish tax reform, implying higher marginal tax rates for the top 5% of the earnings distribution, to learn about earnings responses to higher taxes. Using a simple and graphical cross-sectional method, we estimate an earnings elasticity of 0.16, evaluated four years after the reform. Our analysis indicates that the response is driven by adjustments in wage rates, and not by changes to hours, job switches or income shifting. We interpret the magnitude and preciseness of the response using a realistically calibrated simulation model in which people face uncertain marginal tax rates due to earnings dynamics.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用瑞典最近的一次税收改革，该改革对收入分布前5%的人群提高了边际税率，以了解收入对更高税收的反应。使用一种简单且图形化的横截面方法，我们估计了改革四年后的收入弹性为0.16。我们的分析表明，这种反应是由工资率的调整驱动的，而非工作时间的变化、工作转换或收入转移。我们使用一个现实校准的模拟模型来解释反应的幅度和精确性，在该模型中，人们因收入动态而面临不确定的边际税率。

articles.title_en: Public Good Superstars: A Lab-in-the-Field Study of Wikipedia
articles.title_cn: 公共物品巨星：维基百科的实地实验研究
articles.abstract_en: Many field public goods are provided by a small number of contributors: the ‘superstars’ of their respective communities. This paper focuses on Wikipedia, one of the largest online volunteering platforms. Over nine consecutive years, we study the relationship between social preferences—reciprocity, altruism and social image—and field cooperation. Wikipedia editors are quite prosocial on average, and superstars even more so. But while reciprocal and social image preferences strongly relate to contribution quantity among casual editors, only social image concerns continue to predict differences in contribution levels between superstars. In addition, we find that social image–driven editors—both casual and superstars—contribute lower-quality content on average. Evidence points to a perverse social incentive effect, as quantity is more readily observable than quality on Wikipedia.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多实地公共物品由少数贡献者提供：即各自社区中的“巨星”。本文聚焦于维基百科，这是最大的在线志愿平台之一。在连续九年的时间里，我们研究了社会偏好——互惠、利他和社会形象——与实地合作之间的关系。维基百科编辑平均而言相当亲社会，而巨星更是如此。但是，虽然互惠和社会形象偏好与普通编辑的贡献数量密切相关，但只有社会形象关注继续预测巨星之间贡献水平的差异。此外，我们发现，受社会形象驱动的编辑——无论是普通编辑还是巨星——平均贡献的内容质量较低。证据指向一种反常的社会激励效应，因为在维基百科上，数量比质量更容易被观察到。

articles.title_en: Trade and Domestic Policies under Monopolistic Competition
articles.title_cn: 垄断竞争下的贸易与国内政策
articles.abstract_en: Should trade agreements constrain domestic policies? We analyse this question using a model with monopolistic competition and constant-elasticity-of-substitution demand. We develop a welfare decomposition to show that welfare changes induced by trade and domestic policies can be decomposed into consumption and production efficiencies and terms-of-trade effects. We analyse the reasons to sign trade agreements and compare shallow and deep trade agreements, modelled according to GATT-WTO rules. Under monopolistic competition, unlike deep trade agreements, shallow agreements with market access commitments may not achieve efficiency because terms of trade can be improved without reducing market access by increasing the set of foreign firms selling domestically.
articles.abstract_cn: 贸易协议是否应约束国内政策？我们使用一个具有垄断竞争和不变替代弹性需求模型来分析这一问题。我们发展了一个福利分解，表明贸易和国内政策引起的福利变化可以分解为消费效率、生产效率以及贸易条件效应。我们分析了签署贸易协议的原因，并比较了根据GATT-WTO规则建模的浅层和深层贸易协议。在垄断竞争下，与深层贸易协议不同，具有市场准入承诺的浅层协议可能无法实现效率，因为可以通过增加在国内销售的外国企业集合来改善贸易条件，而不减少市场准入。

articles.title_en: ‘They Never had a Chance’: Unequal Opportunities and Fair Redistributions
articles.title_cn: “他们从未有过机会”：不平等机会与公平再分配
articles.abstract_en: A meritocratic fairness ideal typically asserts that income inequality is justifiable if it arises from differences in performance rather than mere luck. In this study, we present experimental evidence that reveals how merit judgements are influenced by the sources of performance differentials, while holding fixed the underlying impact on incentives to perform. Drawing inspiration from real-world factors that create inequality, we investigate unequal opportunities in education and employment that impact performance. Contrary to some earlier findings suggesting that merit judgements are unaffected by unequal circumstances, our study demonstrates that individuals’ redistributive behaviour is responsive to both the nature and extent of these unequal opportunities. This research thus provides fresh insights into the nuanced factors that motivate people to endorse income redistribution.
articles.abstract_cn: 精英主义的公平理想通常主张，如果收入不平等源于表现差异而非纯粹运气，则是合理的。在本研究中，我们提供了实验证据，揭示了在保持对表现激励的潜在影响不变的情况下， merit 判断如何受到表现差异来源的影响。借鉴现实世界中造成不平等的因素，我们调查了影响表现的教育和就业中的不平等机会。与早期一些认为 merit 判断不受不平等环境影响的发现相反，我们的研究表明，个体的再分配行为对这些不平等机会的性质和程度均有响应。因此，本研究为促使人们支持收入再分配的细微因素提供了新的见解。

articles.title_en: Transitory Income Windfalls and Charitable Giving: Evidence from Norwegian Register Data, 1993–2021
articles.title_cn: 暂时性收入意外之财与慈善捐赠：来自挪威登记数据的证据，1993-2021
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the impact of unearned, transitory income shocks on charitable giving using Norwegian administrative data. We exploit the random timing and size of lottery wins and our long time period (1993–2021) to estimate both short- and longer-term impacts. We find no meaningful effect of small windfalls. Yet, windfalls exceeding $10,000 induce a long-lasting increase in the likelihood to donate, the absolute level of donations and the share of annual income donated (conditional on donating). We show that this is consistent with individuals thinking of large transitory income shocks as a long-term addition to their annual income.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用挪威行政数据研究非劳动所得、暂时性收入冲击对慈善捐赠的影响。我们利用彩票中奖的随机时间和金额以及我们长期的时间跨度（1993-2021）来估计短期和长期影响。我们发现小额意外之财没有显著影响。然而，超过$10,000的意外之财会持久地增加捐赠的可能性、捐赠的绝对水平以及（在捐赠条件下）年收入中捐赠的比例。我们表明，这与个人将大额暂时性收入冲击视为其年收入的长期增加是一致的。

articles.title_en: Entrepreneurial Reluctance: Talent and Firm Creation in China
articles.title_cn: 创业回避：中国的才能与企业创建
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the correlation between cognitive ability and firm creation. Drawing on administrative college admission data and firm registration records in China, we investigate who had created firms by their mid-thirties. We find a clear pattern of entrepreneurial reluctance: given the same backgrounds, individuals with higher college entrance exam scores are less likely to create firms. Through an exploration of firm performance, alternative career trajectories and variations across regions, we propose an explanation: the ability represented by exam scores is useful across occupations, yet higher-scoring individuals are attracted to waged jobs, particularly those of the state sector.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了认知能力与企业创建之间的相关性。利用中国的行政大学录取数据和公司注册记录，我们调查了到三十多岁时谁创建了企业。我们发现了一个明显的创业回避模式：在相同背景下，高考成绩较高的个体创建企业的可能性较低。通过对企业绩效、替代职业轨迹和地区差异的探索，我们提出了一种解释：考试分数所代表的能力在各职业中都有用，但高分个体更倾向于受薪工作，尤其是国有部门的工作。

articles.abstract_en: Reporting private information is a key part of economic decision-making. A recent literature has found that many people have a preference for honest reporting, contrary to usual economic assumptions. In this paper, we investigate whether preferences for honesty are malleable and what determines them. We experimentally measure preferences for honesty in a sample of children. As our main result, we provide causal evidence on the effect of the social environment by randomly enrolling children in a year-long mentoring programme. We find that, about four years after the end of the programme, mentored children are significantly more honest.
articles.abstract_cn: 报告私人信息是经济决策的关键部分。近期的文献发现，与通常的经济学假设相反，许多人有诚实报告的偏好。在本文中，我们研究了诚实偏好是否具有可塑性及其决定因素。我们在儿童样本中通过实验测量了诚实偏好。作为主要结果，我们通过随机将儿童纳入为期一年的辅导项目，提供了社会环境影响的因果证据。我们发现，在项目结束约四年后，接受辅导的儿童显著更加诚实。

articles.title_en: Acceptance of Inequality Between Children: Large-Scale Experimental Evidence from China and Norway
articles.title_cn: 儿童间不平等的接受度：来自中国和挪威的大规模实验证据
articles.abstract_en: In a novel large-scale experiment, we study how adults in two societies, Shanghai (China) and Norway, make real distributive decisions involving children. We find that acceptance of inequality between children increases with the ages of the children, is affected by the source of inequality and the cost of redistribution, and is lower than acceptance of inequality between adults. We document a large cross-societal difference in inequality acceptance: adults in Shanghai implement twice as much inequality between children compared with adults in Norway. Finally, we show that the willingness to accept inequality between children is predictive of attitudes to child policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 在一项新颖的大规模实验中，我们研究了两个社会——上海（中国）和挪威——的成年人如何做出涉及儿童的真实的分配决策。我们发现，对儿童间不平等的接受度随儿童年龄的增长而增加，受到不平等来源和再分配成本的影响，并且低于对成人间不平等的接受度。我们记录了在跨社会差异上的显著差异：上海的成年人实施的儿童间不平等程度是挪威成年人的两倍。最后，我们表明，接受儿童间不平等的意愿可以预测对儿童政策的态度。

articles.title_en: Finance and Green Growth: A Comment on De Haas and Popov (2023)
articles.abstract_en: De Haas and Popov (2023) used a forty-eight-country, sixteen-industry and twenty-six-year panel to test how the size and structure of a country’s financial sector affect CO|$_2$| emissions. This comment revisits the results by correcting two coding errors: failing to cluster the SEs and improperly implementing the generalised method of moments (GMM) estimator. Robust SEs are only significant at 10%, while the magnitudes of the GMM results are reduced by a factor of 2 to 4.1 There are inconsistencies between how SEs are calculated in the scripts provided by De Haas and Popov (2023), and how they are described in the main text. For their country panel, the authors stated that the SEs are clustered at the country level. However, in their script, the authors either only adjusted the SEs to account for heteroscedasticity or did not make any SE adjustments. The SEs in Table A1 in Appendix A are clustered at the country level for the first four columns, and account for heteroscedasticity for the GMM estimator. Compared to the results in Table 2 of De Haas and Popov (2023), the precision of the coefficients of interest is reduced. The results are now either statistically insignificant or only significant at the 10% level.

articles.title_en: A Reply to Listo, Saberian and Thivierge (2023)
articles.title_cn: 对 Listo、Saberian 和 Thivierge 的回复 (2023)
articles.abstract_en: We thank Ariel Listo, Soodeh Saberian and Vincent Thivierge for their careful replication of De Haas and Popov (2023)–using the replication data, code and instructions that we made available at the time of publication and after the usual checks by the Journal's data editor. Here we provide our response to the issues that Listo et al. (2023) bring up. ‘For their country panel, the authors mention in the text that they cluster their standard errors at the country level. However, in their script they either only adjusted their standard errors to account for heteroskedasticity or did not make standard error adjustments.’ This refers to page 642 of the published article where, when introducing the exploratory country-level regression framework, we wrote ‘We cluster the standard errors by country’. At the same time, we wrote in the notes to Table 2 (page 648 of the published article) that the reported SEs in this table are heteroscedasticity robust (as far as the non-generalized method of moments (GMM) results are concerned). While the latter is accurate, the text on page 642 is not. This is an unfortunate and inadvertent oversight, which results from tables being updated during the review process without us fully bringing the related text in line. We should have checked the consistency between the text and the table notes more carefully. Having said that, while definitely regrettable, we believe that the implications of this inconsistency are limited for two reasons. First, the main takeaway from Table 2 is robust to clustering the SEs at the country level. Also, when we include China (see Section 5 below), the point estimate on ‘Equity Share’ has a p-value of .10 in the OLS specification and of .06 in the IV specification. When correctly specifying the GMM model (see Section 2 below), the p-value in this GMM specification is .11.1 Second, we always presented the evidence in Table 2 as suggestive and as a first exploratory step in the data analysis. As we wrote on page 650, ‘[...] we consider these country-level regressions mainly as a first exploratory step in our analysis [...]’. Regarding the GMM case, the answer lies in the claim in the next paragraph of Listo et al. (2023):
articles.abstract_cn: 我们感谢 Ariel Listo、Soodeh Saberian 和 Vincent Thivierge 仔细复制了 De Haas 和 Popov (2023)——使用了我们在出版时提供的复制数据、代码和说明，并经过了期刊数据编辑的常规检查。在这里，我们对 Listo 等人提出的问题做出回应。 (2023) 提出。 “对于他们的国家小组，作者在文本中提到他们将标准误差集中在国家层面。然而，在他们的脚本中，他们要么只调整标准误差以考虑异方差性，要么没有进行标准误差调整。”这是指已发表文章的第642页，在介绍探索性国家级回归框架时，我们写道“我们按国家对标准误差进行聚类”。同时，我们在表二（已发表文章的第648页）的注释中写道，该表中报告的SE是异方差稳健的（就非广义矩方法（GMM）结果而言）。虽然后者是准确的，但页面 642 上的文本却不准确。这是一个不幸且无意的疏忽，这是由于我们在审核过程中更新了表格而没有完全使相关文本保持一致所致。我们应该更仔细地检查文本和表注之间的一致性。话虽如此，虽然确实令人遗憾，但我们认为这种不一致的影响是有限的，原因有两个。首先，表 2 的主要结论对于在国家层面对社会企业进行聚类是稳健的。此外，当我们包括中国时（参见下面的 5 节），“股权份额”的点估计在 OLS 规范中的 p 值为 .10，在 IV 规范中为 .06。当正确指定 GMM 模型时（请参阅下面的第 2 节），此 GMM 规范中的 p 值为 .11.1 其次，我们始终将表 2 中的证据作为提示和数据分析中的第一个探索性步骤提供。正如我们在650页上所写，“[...]我们认为这些国家层面的回归主要是我们分析中的第一步探索性步骤[...]”。关于GMM案，答案就在Listo等人下一段的主张中。 （2023）：
